notes.title: Munin Trading Cards
notes.content:
Munin's Trading Cards are now on, featuring a set of runes (from Younger Futhark era) in relation to the Nine Worlds. 

The full set is comprised of the following runes: Maðr, Þurs, Kaun, Iss, Fé, Sól, Bjarkan, Nauð and Óss. 

Hope you enjoy it. Have fun!

notes.title: Munin is now available!
notes.content:
We’re happy to announce that [b] Munin [/b] is now available. 
 
Munin fuses Norse mythology with challenging logical puzzles. It combines classic side-scrolling gameplay with screen elements which can be rotated 360°. By turning the different screen elements, you can open blocked paths, overcome obstacles, and create new passages. Thus columns are converted into bridges, and the ceiling of the cave suddenly becomes a safe bridge. 
 
Along with classic switches and moving levels, the physical properties of a wide variety of objects in the game can also be put to clever use in order to move forward, giving Munin even more game depth. 
 
Will you break the curse and free Odin’s raven? Think around the corner and you may succeed!
